label: 29 Peer table dashboard
info: The peer table as a live Dashboard 2.0 table, plus a rolling event log. Requires @flowfuse/node-red-dashboard.

name: Requires Dashboard 2.0
info:
Install first:

    npm i @flowfuse/node-red-dashboard

Then deploy and open /dashboard/peers.

Everything on this page is built from received traffic — nothing in the
peer table is configured. Fields stay blank until a message carrying
them arrives, so identity and mode appear well before position, GPS,
battery or home.

The upper table replaces its rows every 2 s from a `state` snapshot.
The lower one appends, capped at 200 rows, from a `state` feed
subscribed to all ten peer-table events.

Example 28 is the same data in debug panes, with no dependencies.
